The '''Razor Assault Ship''' was a class of [[assault ship]] with a long horizontal body. At least one such [[Starship|vessel]] was part of the [[Citizens' Fleet]] that assisted the [[Resistance]] in their [[Battle of Exegol|fight]] against the [[Final Order|forces]] of the reborn [[Darth Sidious]] at the [[planet]] [[Exegol]]. Together, the Resistance and citizen forces successfully defeated the [[Sith Eternal]]'s fleet of [[Xyston-class Star Destroyer|Star Destroyers]].

==Characteristics==
A model of [[assault ship]],<ref name="Kids" /> the Razor Assault Ship had a horizontally-oriented design. Its thin and angular body widened at one end, where two large wings branched out. The assault ship was equipped with a [[hyperdrive]] and possessed five [[engine]]s, four of which were situated at the ship's wider end, with the remaining engine positioned at the other.<ref name="TROS" />

==History==
[[File:GalaxyFleet.png|thumb|left|280px|The citizens' fleet at Exegol included at least one Razor Assault Ship.]]
In [[35 ABY]],<ref name="Date">''[[Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: The Visual Dictionary]]'' places the events of [[Star Wars: Episode IX The Rise of Skywalker|''Star Wars'': Episode IX ''The Rise of Skywalker'']] one [[Standard year|year]] after the [[Hosnian Cataclysm]]. As the Hosnian Cataclysm is dated to [[34 ABY]] by ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'', the events of ''The Rise of Skywalker'', including the appearance of the Razor Assault Ship, take place in [[35 ABY]].</ref> at least one Razor Assault Ship was present in the [[Citizens' Fleet]], a [[fleet]] of unaffiliated starships assembled by [[General]] [[Landonis Balthazar Calrissian|Lando Calrissian]] to assist the [[Resistance]]. The fleet traveled to the [[planet]] [[Exegol]] to aid the Resistance [[Resistance navy|forces]] in the [[Battle of Exegol]] against the [[Final Order]], a [[Xyston-class Star Destroyer|''Xyston''-class Star Destroyer]] fleet of the [[Sith Eternal]] commanded by the resurrected [[Darth Sidious]]. Shortly after the arrival of the citizens' fleet, a Razor Assault Ship flew past an exploding Sith Star Destroyer alongside several [[starfighter]]s.<ref name="TROS" />

During the battle, Sidious disabled the Resistance and citizen fleets with [[Force lightning]], but numerous vessels, including a Razor Assault Ship, were able to recover when he was distracted by an attack from the [[Jedi]] [[Rey Skywalker|Rey]]. The arrival of the citizens' fleet ultimately helped the Resistance to win the battle.<ref name="TROS" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|This one got a lot of traction. It's got an unexpected way of flying.|James Clyne, on the ''Buckshot'' design that became the Razor Assault Ship|<ref name="Art of Solo">''[[The Art of Solo: A Star Wars Story]]''</ref>}}
The Razor Assault Ship appeared in the [[2019]] [[sequel trilogy]] film, [[Star Wars: Episode IX The Rise of Skywalker|''Star Wars'': Episode IX ''The Rise of Skywalker'']].<ref name="TROS" /> The ship was first identified in the video "Every Ship in the Star Wars Sequel Trilogy," posted on the [[StarWarsKids.com|''Star Wars'' Kids]] [[Wikipedia:YouTube|YouTube]] channel on [[July 31]], [[2020]].<ref name="Kids" />

[[File:Buckshot_Razor_concept.png|thumb|right|310px|The ''Buckshot'' concept art that was later used for the Razor Assault Ship.]]
The design of the Razor Assault Ship is based on unused concept art<ref name="Twitter">{{Twitter|HolocronKeeper|status/1289384735307788289|[[Leland Chee]]|quote=It's based on concept art you can see in the Art of Solo book by @PhilSzostak {{C|In response to: "Great...any other images of the Razor Assault Ship?"}}|archiveurl=https://archive.is/CitEq}}</ref> created by [[James Clyne]] for the [[Aerie (carrier)|''Buckshot'']], a [[carrier]] ship that was intended to be used by [[Enfys Nest]] and the [[Cloud-Riders]] in the [[2018]] film ''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story]]''. In ''[[The Art of Solo: A Star Wars Story]]'', Clyne noted that the particular design that became the Razor Assault Ship gained some traction and speculated on its usage as a background [[Easter egg (virtual)|Easter egg]] in the film during the scenes in the [[First Light|yacht]] of [[Dryden Vos]] at [[Fort Ypso]].<ref name="Art of Solo" />
